open_item_bindings.effect_on_this_scenario: no value effect: design 14:429 states the position is closed immediately BEFORE the event timestamp, so it is ineligible under an INCLUDE rule as well as under an EXCLUDE rule. The INCLUDE answer creates a separate build obligation (a fill AT the exact funding timestamp) that this declared vector does not exercise; that obligation is recorded in the applicability draft and is not a CONTRACT_TABLES cell.

open_item_bindings.owner_disposition: CLOSED (5a) - the closed-lifecycle premise is built with ordinary price bars before the observation window, by the real mechanism, with nothing injected
open_item_bindings.effect_on_this_scenario: design 22.6:889 left the LEGACY premise as [OPEN-EMBED-05] and design 15.6:571 blocked the runnable premise and its dependent cells. The owner answer makes the premise reachable: lifecycle 1 opens and closes on ordinary bars before 2000-01-01T00:00:00Z, so at the window start no position is eligible for TEST-FUND-1. Because those fills are outside the observation window they contribute no in-window fill, cash, fee or exit facts, which is exactly the empty-container reading this artifact already sealed; the sealed values are unchanged and are now premise-supported rather than premise-blocked. The owner answer does not name the exact pre-window bars, so no bar-level cell is authored here.

derivable_empty_containers_note: all six economic containers are derivably empty inside the observation window. Design 14:429: the required event coverage is present, no position is eligible, and no funding row is emitted. Owner addendum 20 (5a) places the opening and closing fills of lifecycle 1 on ordinary bars BEFORE the window, so they contribute no in-window fill, cash, fee, gross-realization or exit fact, and no CostSchedule is consumed (design 22.6:889). trades is [] on the same window-scoped reading; the pre-window close mutates no in-window equity and the vector fixes the compared projection at 1000.
